project_context.description: SaaS anti no-show web application for restaurants, salons, and coaches.

theme_strategy.instructions: Implement a theme toggler (Sun/Moon). Use CSS variables for all colors to ensure seamless switching.

headings.usage: Use for all page titles, card headers, and marketing slogans. Tracking tight (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, inputs, and data tables. readable on small screens.

mono.usage: Use for ID numbers, verification codes, and financial metrics.

primary.name: Forest Green
primary.explanation: Represents growth, money saved, and reliability. Avoids the generic 'SaaS Blue'.

secondary.name: Warm Sand
secondary.explanation: Grounds the app in a physical, tangible reality. Not sterile white.

accent.name: Alert Orange
accent.explanation: Use for 'No-show' risks and urgent actions.

spacing.strategy: Mobile-First Dense. Use 'p-4' as default for cards, 'gap-3' for lists. On Desktop, expand to 'p-8'.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full font-bold shadow-soft transition-all active:scale-95

cards.dashboard: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-2xl border border-border/50 shadow-sm p-5
cards.stats: bg-primary/5 border-none rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between

inputs.style: h-12 rounded-xl bg-background border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 transition-all

navigation.mobile: Fixed bottom bar with large touch targets (min 44px). Glassmorphism effect.

layout_patterns.mobile_container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-background relative overflow-hidden
layout_patterns.form_layout: Single column on mobile. Labels above inputs. Big submit buttons at bottom sticky.

motion.instructions: Use 'AnimatePresence' for page transitions. Use 'layout' prop for list reordering.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons scale down 0.95 on click. Toggles have spring physics.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Rounded line joins.

images.alt: Busy restaurant owner managing appointments on phone

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic 'Inter' font for headings.
Mobile-first: Touch targets must be at least 44x44px.
Bilingual support: Ensure UI can handle text expansion for French (approx 1.2x length of English).
Components are in .jsx format. Import them correctly.
Do NOT use 'transparent' backgrounds for dropdowns/headers that overlay content.
Use 'Forest Green' (#15803d) for success/primary actions to emphasize money saved.
implementation_steps: 1. Configure Tailwind colors in 'tailwind.config.js' with the new palette.
2. Set up the 'Manrope' and 'Outfit' fonts in 'index.css'.
3. Create the 'Layout' component with Mobile/Desktop responsive logic.
4. Build the 'Auth' pages (Login/Register) with the new visual style.
5. Develop the 'Dashboard' shell with the Bottom Nav (Mobile) and Sidebar (Desktop).
